---
name: main
# Automatically cancel a previous run.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
# yamllint disable rule:line-length
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'
jobs:
  run-tests:
    name: Run tests for ${{ matrix.os }} on Python 3.14
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - name: Install TinyTex
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-tinytex@v2
      - name: Install additional LaTeX packages
        run: |
          tlmgr update --self
          tlmgr install a4wide biber biblatex booktabs caption datetime doi eurosym fancyhdr fmtcount grfext microtype minibox moreverb natbib ntgclass relsize setspace units xetex xfrac xunicode
          tlmgr list --only-installed
      - uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.10.1
        with:
          pixi-version: v0.77.0
          cache: true
          cache-write: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == 'main' }}
          activate-environment: true
          frozen: true
      - name: Install npm packages
        shell: bash {0}
        run: pixi run install-npm
      - name: Run pytest on MacOS / Windows
        shell: bash {0}
        run: pixi run pytest
        if: runner.os != 'Linux'
      - name: Run pytest (with coverage) on Linux
        shell: bash {0}
        run: pixi run pytest --cov-report=xml --cov=./
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7.0.0
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
  run-docs:
    name: Run docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.10.1
        with:
          pixi-version: v0.77.0
          cache: true
          cache-write: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == 'main' }}
          activate-environment: true
          frozen: true
      - name: Build docs
        shell: bash {0}
        run: pixi run build-docs
      - name: Check validity of URLs
        shell: bash {0}
        run: pixi run check-urls
  run-ty:
    name: Run ty
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      - uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.10.1
        with:
          pixi-version: v0.77.0
          cache: true
          cache-write: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == 'main' }}
          frozen: true
      - name: Run ty
        run: pixi run prek run ty --all-files
        shell: bash -el {0}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
